title: [MCP] Add Agent Tools server feature
summary: MCP server now includes Agent Tools feature for managing and loading available custom agents through the native agent configuration contract.
key_points: Adds Agent Tools MCP server feature (Preview/Billable) backed by native agent configuration
Introduces Available Agents management UI for active custom agents
Loads agent system tools through MCP Utilities
Includes public configuration APIs, lifecycle handling, import/export support, and permissions
Adds telemetry and comprehensive regression test coverage
quote: Add the Agents Tools (Preview/Billable) MCP server feature backed by the native agent configuration contract.
